# Verovio slim build

Verovio 6.2.0, commit `43f806031bfff2c64003fc8ddd9910820445f6ab`.
Copyright Laurent Pugin and contributors; LGPL-3.0-or-later.

`verovio-module.mjs` is generated by `npm run build:verovio` using Emscripten
4.0.20. `build.json` records the source and artifact checksums and exclusions.
M3N removes unused fonts, input formats, editor code and C API exports,
then applies size optimization and link-time optimization. The source patch
repairs incomplete MusicXML/editor exclusion guards; the accidental converter
shared with MEI tuning is preserved verbatim. Engraving and playback algorithms
are unchanged. The recipe pins the version header instead of reading the
enclosing M3N Git checkout.

The JavaScript toolkit wrapper remains the exact `verovio@6.2.0` npm dependency;
only the methods listed in `build.json` have WASM exports. Both production code
and renderer tests use this slim module.

Licenses, font notices, the original source archive and the complete build
recipe ship at [`public/licenses/verovio`](../../../../public/licenses/verovio).
See [`docs/VEROVIO_BUILD.md`](../../../../docs/VEROVIO_BUILD.md) for rebuilding, verification
and size measurements. Generated artifacts are committed so a normal build
does not require a C++ toolchain or a network download.
